core_obligations: Quote the base change result for one implication (proof line 4476).
Use Artin-Rees to replace vanishing of the extended ideal by the equivalent conditions modulo powers of the maximal ideal, and reduce to the Artinian case (proof lines 4477-4499).
In the Artinian case, let J be the kernel of the local map and reduce the claim to flatness of the module modulo J at the primes over the maximal ideal (proof lines 4500-4503).
Use that flatness over the Artinian target descends along the injective local map of Artinian rings to conclude (proof lines 4504-4506).
proof_roadmap: One implication from the base change lemma (proof line 4476).
Reduce to an Artinian local target via Artin-Rees (proof lines 4477-4499).
Descend flatness along the injective Artinian map (proof lines 4500-4506).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises the local Noetherian base changes along which the module of the preceding flattening result becomes flat at the primes over the maximal ideal: they are exactly the base changes in which the flattening ideal dies. One implication is quoted from the base change result for that condition. For the other, the author uses Artin-Rees in the Noetherian target to replace vanishing of the extended ideal by annihilation modulo every power of the maximal ideal, observes that the condition passes to the quotients, and thereby reduces to an Artinian local target. In that case the condition says the base changed module is flat, the kernel of the local map is used to rewrite the base change, and flatness descends along the resulting injective local map of Artinian rings.
